catalog.name: System Overview
catalog.description: One panel for CPU, GPU and RAM, with optional VRAM and network. Each section has its own colour, ring, stats and smooth graph, and the CPU section adds a core heatmap that brightens with load. Shows as activity rings at 1×1.
catalog.props:
sections ['cpu','gpu','ram','vram','net']
colors { cpu, gpu, ram, vram, net } | unifiedColor
ring 'ring'|'none', coreView 'heatmap'|'bars'|'off'
heatRamp, details 'auto'|'min'|'full'

catalog.name: Menu Bar
catalog.description: An always-visible glance strip in the style of iStat Menus: each label sits over its value, with mini history bars. Click an item to open its detail panel.

catalog.name: KPI Tiles
catalog.description: The four numbers you check first. Each tile shows the value, its change over recent readings, and a trend line with a live end dot.

catalog.name: Status Tracker
catalog.description: A history of states with one block per reading: OK, 50–80%, above 80% / down, or no data. Hover a block to see its value.
catalog.props:
tracks [{ label, key, kind, warn, crit, up }]
samples

catalog.name: System Status
catalog.description: CPU + RAM load and Data API health.

catalog.name: Vitals
catalog.description: CPU, GPU, RAM and network side by side. Shows as a row in wide zones, a 2×2 grid in square ones and a stack in tall ones.

catalog.name: Service Health
catalog.description: Status board for every data source: Data API, LibreHW, RTSS, Wave Link, Spotify, Steam, weather and network.

catalog.name: Processes
catalog.description: Top processes by CPU or memory plus process, thread and handle counts.

catalog.name: Uptime
catalog.description: Time since boot, split into days, hours, minutes and seconds.

catalog.name: CPU Monitor
catalog.description: Total and per-core load as bars or a heatmap. Also shows clocks, Tctl, package power, VID, VRM and CPU fan.
catalog.props:
coreView 'bars'|'heatmap'|'off'
coreMetric 'load'|'clock'
heatRamp 'accent'|'thermal'
cpu, warn, crit

catalog.name: Core Heatmap
catalog.description: Per-core heatmap: grid, honeycomb, radial or scrolling waterfall, in seven colour ramps.

catalog.name: GPU Rings
catalog.description: Stacked radial rings, used only for bounded percentages: VRAM on the outside, core load inside, temperature in the centre. A legend lists clocks, power and fans.

catalog.name: GPU Monitor
catalog.description: Load, core and hotspot temps, power, VRAM, clocks, fans and D3D engines.

catalog.name: Memory
catalog.description: Physical and virtual memory: load, used and available.

catalog.name: Thermals
catalog.description: Every temperature in one list, hottest first, with a warning marker on each row.

catalog.name: Power Draw
catalog.description: CPU and GPU package watts as a split bar, with a history of the total.

catalog.name: Fans
catalog.description: GPU fans with duty % plus the CPU fan. Each icon spins in proportion to its RPM.

catalog.name: Drive Space
catalog.description: Used and free space per volume, with label, type and file system.

catalog.name: SSD Health
catalog.description: SMART life, temperature, read/write rate, activity, TBW, spare and power-on hours.

catalog.name: Disk I/O
catalog.description: Read and write throughput for every physical disk, plus a combined history.

catalog.name: Network Traffic
catalog.description: Live download and upload rate with history, totals and utilisation for any adapter.

catalog.name: Network Adapters
catalog.description: Public IP plus each adapter’s status, link speed, IPv4 and IPv6.

catalog.name: Now Playing
catalog.description: Track, artist, album, cover art and progress from Windows Media, Spotify or a pushed source.
catalog.props:
source 'auto'|'media'|'spotify'|'pushed'
layout 'card'|'vinyl'|'backdrop'|'wave'
progress 'bar'|'wave'|'visualizer'
vizMode, vizDevice, vizRamp, showTimeline
showArt

catalog.name: Audio Meter
catalog.description: L/R LED meter with peak, RMS, hold and level, or a meter bridge showing every device.

catalog.name: Volume Mixer
catalog.description: Volume and mute for each device, plus the default device and Wave Link status.

catalog.name: Meter Bridge
catalog.description: Studio-style meters for every channel: a dB scale, stereo LED ladders with dimmed zone colours, peak hold, volume and L/R dB readouts. Switches to horizontal rows in short zones.
catalog.props:
channels [names|ids], orientation
ladder 'led'|'smooth', segments, floor
warnDb, clipDb, holdMs, showScale, showVolume

catalog.name: Visualizer
catalog.description: Canvas audio visualiser driven by the level meter: bars, mirror, radial, wave, blob or LED dots.
catalog.props:
mode 'bars'|'mirror'|'radial'|'wave'|'blob'|'dots'
device, ramp, bands, sensitivity, peaks

catalog.name: Wave Link
catalog.description: Elgato Wave Link inputs with mute and gain, and live L/R meters for each channel.

catalog.name: Clock
catalog.description: Digital or analog clock with date, 12/24 h and seconds.

catalog.name: Calendar
catalog.description: Today’s date plus a month grid, taken from the clock plugin.

catalog.name: Weather
catalog.description: Conditions, feels-like, wind, humidity, pressure, rain or snow, and a 7-day forecast.

catalog.name: Forecast
catalog.description: Daily forecast with hi/lo range bars. Runs across in wide zones and down in tall ones.

catalog.name: FPS Monitor
catalog.description: RTSS frame rate, 1% low, frame-time graph, min/avg/max, display and API.

catalog.name: Game Spotlight
catalog.description: Now playing for games: the Steam hero banner with slow Ken Burns motion, game logo, poster and icon, plus session, playtime, FPS, achievements and friends. The combo layout overlays the current music track.

catalog.name: OSD Strip
catalog.description: An in-game overlay strip like RTSS or Afterburner: cells in a fixed order with monospace digits, and colour only when a value drops.

catalog.name: Frame Pacing
catalog.description: A frame-time graph with budget lines for your refresh rate and for 60 Hz. Average FPS hides stutter; frame-time spikes show it.

catalog.name: Playtime Share
catalog.description: How the last two weeks of play split between games, as one bar with a segment per game sized by its share.

catalog.name: Steam Profile
catalog.description: Avatar, persona, status, level and friends online or in-game, with recent activity.

catalog.name: Current Game
catalog.description: Hero art, session time, playtime, average session and achievement progress.

catalog.name: Achievements
catalog.description: Completion ring for the current game, unlocked/total and the latest unlock.

catalog.name: Steam Library
catalog.description: Games owned, total and recent playtime, recent games and game news.

catalog.name: Game News
catalog.description: The latest headlines for the current game and your library.

catalog.name: Sensor
catalog.description: Bind any single data point and show it as a value, gauge, bar or sparkline with thresholds.
catalog.props:
sensor (key), label
display 'value'|'gauge'|'bar'|'spark'
min, max, warn, crit, decimals

catalog.name: Sensor Group
catalog.description: Bind any list of data points, shown as rows or a tile grid, each with an optional bar and thresholds.
catalog.props:
sensors [{ key, label, max, warn, crit }]
layout 'auto'|'rows'|'grid', bars

AudioMeter.name: Audio Meter

Calendar.name: Calendar

Clock.name: Clock
Clock.description: Digital or analog clock with date, 12/24h and seconds.

CoreHeatmap.name: Core Heatmap
CoreHeatmap.description: Per-core CPU heatmap in four shapes: grid, honeycomb, radial and a scrolling waterfall, with selectable colour ramps.

CpuMonitor.name: CPU Monitor
CpuMonitor.description: Total + per-core load, clocks, temperature, package power, VID, VRM and fan.

DiskIO.name: Disk I/O
DiskIO.description: Read / write throughput and activity for every physical disk, plus combined history.

DriveSpace.name: Drive Space
DriveSpace.description: Used / free space per volume with label, type and file system.

Fans.name: Fans

Forecast.name: Forecast

FpsMonitor.name: FPS Monitor

GpuMonitor.name: GPU Monitor
GpuMonitor.description: Load, temps, power, VRAM, clocks, fans, PCIe and D3D engines.

GpuRings.name: GPU Rings

KpiTiles.name: KPI Tiles

MemoryUsage.name: Memory

MenuBar.name: Menu Bar

MeterBridge.name: Meter Bridge

NetworkAdapters.name: Network Adapters

NetworkThroughput.name: Network Traffic
NetworkThroughput.description: Live download / upload rate with history, totals and utilisation per adapter.

NowPlaying.name: Now Playing

OsdStrip.name: OSD Strip
OsdStrip.description: In-game overlay strip (RTSS / Afterburner OSD): fixed cell order, monospace digits, colour only when a value drops.

PlaytimeShare.name: Playtime Share
PlaytimeShare.description: How the last two weeks of play split between games — one bar, segments sized by share — with sessions and library totals.

PowerDraw.name: Power Draw
PowerDraw.description: CPU package + GPU package watts, split bar, total history and GPU board-power limit.

ProcessList.name: Processes
ProcessList.description: Top processes by CPU or memory, plus process / thread / handle counts.

SensorGroup.name: Sensor Group
SensorGroup.description: Bind any list of data points. Rows or a tile grid, each with optional bar and thresholds.

SensorValue.name: Sensor
SensorValue.description: Bind any single data point. Shows it as a value, gauge, bar or sparkline with thresholds.

ServiceHealth.name: Service Health

StatusTracker.description: History of a state, one block per reading (Tremor Tracker style): OK, 50–80 %, above 80 %, no data. Hover a block for its value.

SteamProfile.name: Steam Profile
SteamProfile.description: Avatar, persona, status, level and friends online / in-game with recent activity.

StorageHealth.name: SSD Health
StorageHealth.description: SMART life, temperature, read/write rate, activity, TBW, spare and power-on hours.

SystemOverview.name: System Overview

SystemStatus.name: System Status

Thermals.name: Thermals

Uptime.name: Uptime
Uptime.description: Time since boot as days / hours / minutes / seconds.

Visualizer.name: Visualizer
Visualizer.description: Canvas audio visualiser driven by the level meter (L/R + level): bars, mirror, radial, wave, blob and LED-dot modes at 60 fps.

Vitals.name: Vitals
Vitals.description: CPU, GPU, RAM and network side-by-side. Reflows into a row, 2×2 grid or stack to suit the zone.

VolumeMixer.name: Volume Mixer

WaveLink.name: Wave Link
